1.reason: follow-up: pin the retry window with independent delay values

findings.text: the bound assertion compares the recorded arm bound against a call to landing_measure.arm_bound built from the same stored record the test supplied, so both sides move with the code under test and it holds even if arm_bound is reverted to the floor; the literals at :137-:138 carry the guard.

the retry window is built from queue_landing._retry_backoff, the same function _refusal_holds calls, so the case passes for any back-off value including zero; only :262-:267 pins the delay values independently.

_retry_backoff re-implements the capped doubling delay owned at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:553 (_retry_delay) and reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:772 (next_backoff); a helper parameterised by base and cap would own the formula once.

_stored_measurements walks every run directory and parses each landing-measure/measurement.json on every measured run, so a runs directory of the size reckon/crew/review.py:2970 records (4,233 entries) costs that many file reads per run inside the pass that exists to keep work unstuck; read the history once per pass.
